pretreatments.description: Thermophilic Pretreatment (TPP) involved mixing food waste (FW) with inoculum and incubating the mixture at temperatures ranging from 50 to 80 °C for durations of 12 to 48 hours. After the treatment phase, the temperature was reduced to mesophilic conditions (35 ± 2 °C) prior to mesophilic anaerobic digestion.
Conventional Thermal Pretreatment (CTP) involved heating only the food waste without inoculum to 50–80 °C for the desired pretreatment duration, followed by inoculation at mesophilic conditions.
